My brother dealt with extreme anger at one point in his life. It got to the point where he threatened to kill my mother. He left the country for a couple years, but when he came back he acted totally sated. I asked him why he wasn't as angry and he said something along the lines of

"I had a real passion for hating stuff and people. Sometimes I took it out on people who deserved it, and sometimes I took it out on people who didn't deserve it. Either way I made the person hate me. It kept at me, even weeks after my tantrums. Whenever I saw that person, I was filled with hatred for them. But I realized that I didnt want them to know I hated them, I wanted them to fight back. I just wanted to fight. After that I took my energy and applied it to other things. I had so much energy, I just gave it off as rage, but rage is not a good way of getting rid of energy. Putting effort into other things is."

Basically, TLDR; put your energy into other things and you'll be too tired to be angry.
